programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -神祕仰慕者之謎
programme.desc: When Alex receives an unsigned note from a “secret admirer”, he calls on Addison to help him find out who thinks he's so wonderful.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -午夜忍者之謎
programme.desc: When it appears that a midnight vandal is damaging Max's entry in the town's “Most Beautiful Public Garden” project, Addison goes undercover ninja to save the day.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -銀器
programme.desc: Re-using the silverware to make something so awesome that it has left us in awe.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -舊枕套
programme.desc: Yawn! After a good ol nap let's re-use our pillow covers.

programme.title: 優可 -不准碰
programme.desc: When Vik doesn't want to share his brand-new ball, his friends use inventive “super-spy skills” to change his mind.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -雪怪日
programme.desc: Ricky hears that a yeti has been spotted in Bristol. After making a camouflage picture inspired by Rousseau and an ice cream-shaped pinata, Ricky's determined to lure the mysterious beast and be the first to photograph it.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -作夢日
programme.desc: Ricky is having weird dreams and makes surreal art, including giant hands and a burger hat inspired by Rene Magritte. After scoffing some cheesy snacks, Ricky gets his pajamas on to create illuminating dream art.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -蝙蝠大旅社
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents a dog-washing wand, a Bat hotel that keeps bugs away, a device that allows doctors to examine people on the other side of the world, and the inventors of the Chairless Chair.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -狗食大主廚
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents a man who started a business that cooks fresh food for pets, a wireless phone-charging purse, a medicine-free pain-relieving device and a teenager who invented a novel way to clean water.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -熊熊火焰
programme.desc: Dry weather caused by climate change has caused a forest fire, and the Black Forest is ablaze. Only the MeteoHeroes can prevent an environmental catastrophe! Pluvia and Nubess are on their way to the North Sea.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -綠色海浪, 上集
programme.desc: There is trouble in the Yellow Sea: the algae have grown into a thick layer on the ocean's surface, suffocating the sea life below it. Margherita Rita sends Ventum and Pluvia to tackle this problem.

programme.title: 地球小尖兵 -蠕蟲農夫
programme.desc: Kids meet a worm farmer.

programme.title: 打造貓樂園 -貓咖啡廳
programme.desc: OEistein makes a cardboard cat cafe.

programme.title: 全球探險家霍吉 -霍吉去濟州島
programme.desc: Bernie loses his glasses on a trip to Jeju Island! Luckily for him, Hogie makes friends with Min-ja, who has heaps of knowledge about the island of Jeju, and who can ask her big family for some extra help.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -蘿絲的童話故事集
programme.desc: Rose's favorite Fairy Tale Collection is confiscated by Doctor LeFrog because she's distracted from her potions assignment. When Vicky and Shire Cat create a potion causing campus dragons to shrink and grow chaotically, our heroes need Rose's collection to save the day.

programme.title: 神奇小百科 -巨人喜歡六邊形嗎
programme.desc: The Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland is made up of around 40,000 interlocking basalt columns, most of which are hexagonal. Nature is very efficient, so it uses this hexagonal arrangement in many places, such as bubbles and beehives.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -衝浪蝸牛
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers return to Table Mountain National Park in South Africa to discover the strange ways animals have adapted to survive in their secret worlds. Along the way they meet bats, surfing snails, and an army of ants protecting unusual plants.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -海底之下
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers dive into the water at Table Mountain National Park and discover starfish and sea anemones. Then they head out to sea in a research boat and meet a school of Sevengill Cow Sharks.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -壞運之魚
programme.desc: Fontaine believes that a fish is responsible for wrecking Dolos' boat, sinking the Aronnax, and placing the Rover in deadly jeopardy.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -奇怪的遷徙
programme.desc: The Rover is swallowed by a huge shark! Will and Fontaine end up in its mouth. It's up to Kaiko and Ant to try to find a way to free them.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -維京人
programme.desc: Like Raven and Little Lewis, the famous giants of the northern mists, the Vikings, are master looters and navigators. Besides being bloody warriors and shrewd negotiators, the Vikings are also great explorers, out to discover the world.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -領主與農民
programme.desc: Our humble peasant friend Howler can't wait for his next batch of pretzels! However, in the Middle Ages, the feudal system is ruthless, the lord always helping himself to a share of the peasant's yield. And, quite often, all that's left is a few meager crumbs.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -小狗
programme.desc: Naomi is overjoyed with her new puppy-until it mysteriously vanishes before her friends Carol and Jessi arrive. Convinced it's been stolen, she accuses everyone, but nothing adds up. Did someone really take the puppy, or is there more to the story.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -洗腦旋律
programme.desc: Motor creates the catchiest tune ever-everyone's hooked, from Jessi to the whole world... except Flippy. As the tune turns into a global obsession of endless humming and dancing, Motor must uncover why Flippy is immune-and if he can help save the world.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -騎士們
programme.desc: Little Lewis follows every step in order to achieve his dream. After completing a plethora of thankless tasks at a young age, he moves on to the rank of ‘squire.' A chance to demonstrate his bravery on the battlefield, in order to be knighted, at last.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -植物吃喝什麼
programme.desc: How can we prove plants and flowers drink water? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of botany. Have hands-on fun by making a rainbow-coloured flower, and get to know J.C. Bose, an amazing polymath who pioneered studies into the nature of plants.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -彈跳且彎曲的光
programme.desc: What is the difference between reflection and refraction? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of light. Have hands-on fun by mixing oil and water, and get to know Zhang Heng, a great polymath, who figured out the Moon reflects light like a mirror.

programme.title: 優可 -下一次的生日快樂
programme.desc: Oto and Mai throw Vik a basketball-themed birthday party, and Vik learns that the more he plays the sport, the better he gets.

programme.title: 優可 -優可的電腦遊戲
programme.desc: Yoko gets the kids to appreciate nature by tricking them into thinking the park is actually a computer game.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -降低空氣污染
programme.desc: The Grimwades have come to London. Daddy explains how car engines cause air pollution, which is a problem in cities worldwide. The family decides to reduce air pollution by choosing to travel differently. They split into groups.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -重複利用舊照片
programme.desc: The Grimwades decide to reuse some photographs and create their own timeline. The family goes to a local hall, where they can lay out their photos. Mummy surprises them with a large model of planet earth, the place where everyone's story begins.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -潛望鏡
programme.desc: Look round a corner or over a wall, with this clever device you can see like you're tall.

programme.title: 優可 -你好, 大自然
programme.desc: The kids become park rangers, but their bossiness drives people away! Yoko must work her magic to rewind time so they can re-do the day.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -紙直升機
programme.desc: Paper planes need a new twist, so grab your scissors and try making this! Whirl show you how to make a spinning helicopter.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -伊朗之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has to make some complicated calculations, but she has no electronic device at hand that could help her with that, so she is in a bit of a panic. Milo does not seem to have an answer. As for Alim, he sees the solution to her problems in a trip to Iran.

programme.title: 小小致富夢想家 -運動資訊帽
programme.desc: Max is excited to spend the day with tech billionaire Will Hedges, but he's crushed when his hero steals one of his inventions. Zeke gets birthday money from his grandma and the rest of the gang pitch him ideas on how to spend it.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -好多頭髮
programme.desc: Can you lift a car with a ponytail? The doctors put the strength of human hair to the test and find out what makes different colours and types of hair.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克、地圖和指南針
programme.desc: Eric learns how a compass works and makes one using a needle. He discovers that because of the iron at the centre of the Earth and the way the Earth spins, the magnetic field around our planet acts like a giant magnet.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -怎麼在黑暗中看到東西
programme.desc: How do you see in colour? And how can your eyes see in the dark? It's time for Dr. Xand to become Night Vision Man! Plus, we witness a camera go inside Dr. Chris' lungs.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -令人欽佩的水中上將
programme.desc: Eric learns that even if something is made from a material that is denser or heavier than water, it will float if it has the right shape. He makes a paper boat strong enough to carry toy cars without sinking.

programme.title: 體操新星 -一切的起點
programme.desc: It's the Artistic British Championships. Alice is facing strong competition as she is up against Amelie and Phoebe's teammates from the European Championships. Meanwhile, Ekraj is late for podium training and doesn't seem focused on the competition.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -改變一生的手術
programme.desc: Just when Jamie thought he'd conquered his fear of goats, he's sent to the Highlands to track down and treat a giant mountain goat that needs its hooves trimmed. And there's a life-changing operation for a border collie, Joke.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -金牌女孩與太空人
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, Kelly Holmes reflects on how she became a double Olympic gold medallist and Tim Peake shares his journey from test pilot to the UK's first European Space Agency astronaut to stay on the International Space Station.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -消防員與仿生人
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, Sabrina Cohen-Hatton, the most senior ranking firefighter in the UK, and Mark Ormrod, triple amputee and four-time Invictus Games gold medallist, share their incredible stories of resilience.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -獅子無懼之心
programme.desc: Ice hockey player Liam takes on men twice his age in an action-packed match, the Icicles are put through their paces at the dress rehearsal for a big competition, and solo skaters Kloe and Beccy head to the British Championships.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -熱的顏色
programme.desc: Eric learns that wearing light colours in the sun keeps you cooler than dark colours. He does an ice cube experiment to how lighter colours reflect light and heat, just like a mirror.

programme.title: 寵物救援隊 -面臨壓力
programme.desc: Marisa is used to supporting others, but today it's her dog Millie going under the knife. Walter, the Whippet, is a changed dog at home, but how will he cope in the park.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -相同卻不同
programme.desc: This episode is all about capacity. If two containers have the same surface area but one of them is a tall, narrow cylinder and the other one a short, wide one: Can they store the same amount of beads? How is this possible.

programme.title: 神秘大探索: 科學DIY -廚房化學
programme.desc: There's a whole laboratory waiting to be explored in your kitchen. In this episode host Steve Spangler reveals how we can make crazy creations such as soap souffle and elephant toothpaste out of ordinary stuff from the supermarket.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -骨頭
programme.desc: In this episode, Dr Chris and Dr Xand look at bones, and show you an experiment to make them bendy.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -肺
programme.desc: In this episode, Dr Chris and Dr Xand look at lungs, and show you an experiment to measure how much air they can hold.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -哎呀, 我的「堡」
programme.desc: Do you want to know how you can build a really big fort? In this episode Eric reveals an exciting trick. The ingredients? A lot of cushions and the mathematical 'perimeter'. So gather your pillows and get ready for some fort action.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -太陽時間
programme.desc: In this episode we're introduced to the exciting sundial: a clock that uses the position of the sun to show what time it is. It does so by using a stick that casts a shadow upon a surface with time markings on it.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -舞動飾帶
programme.desc: In this episode we learn how math patterns are used as a basis for art, architecture, and even dance movements. Eric shows off some fancy footwork to illustrate the patterning and geometry behind the seven frieze patterns.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -灌籃高手角鬥士炸藥女
programme.desc: Gladiator Dynamite puts Dr Dan and Dr Raph's core muscles to the test, Dr Chris shoots hoops with a basketball dunking champ, while Dr Ronx is lifted into the air by finger power.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -八頭身
programme.desc: In this episode we learn about non-standard measurement units that are often based on the concept of anthropometry: the built-in ratios for body measurements first proposed by Leonardo DaVinci. Can we measure people by merely knowing the size of their heads.

programme.title: 體操新星 -全力以赴
programme.desc: Finn and Kirsten are set for the biggest competition of their lives so far. They have made it into the finals of the Acrobatic World Championships! And now they are up against the best acro gymnasts in the world. Have they got what it takes to win a medal.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -解決問題的人
programme.desc: The Junior Vets need to find out why Tino, the horse, can't walk properly. They help remove a large lump from the throat of Zoe, the Schnauzer dog. And Pollux, the alpaca, is going bald - can the Junior Vets get to the bottom of the problem.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -躍然紙上
programme.desc: In this episode we all turn into paper engineers as we are introduced to the art of origami. With the use of a standard sheet of paper, a few cuts, and some reverse folds, we're able to construct our own 3D objects. Pretty cool.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -優勝者是..
programme.desc: The Junior Vets have spent four weeks at Vet School, and it's time to go home. Now they all have a chance to do one last check-up on their grateful patients and say goodbye. But which one of the kids has impressed Paul enough to take the title of Head Vet.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -歡樂下雨天
programme.desc: After a day of mud sliding, the kids have to problem solve when heavy rain endangers some of the Kiwifruit Valley creatures.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -紙飛機的難題
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts learn about the different shapes of paper planes, and then have to help Heni rescue Burpee from the top of a tree.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -間諜視覺
programme.desc: Eric wants to be a secret agent. He makes a periscope so he can watch the world without being seen. He discovers that the same principle is used by submarines and even by dentists.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瓶中龍捲風
programme.desc: Eric pretends to be a tornado. He finds out they happen when the wind starts rotating really fast in a vortex – a whirlpool shape. Then he learns how to make a tornado using recycled plastic bottles.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -蟲蟲來襲
programme.desc: Eric learns that insects have a head, thorax, abdomen, antennae, and six legs. He is surprised to find out that spiders are not insects – they are arachnids.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -順風飛行
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make the perfect paper plane using symmetry. He finds out that real planes use the same principle as paper planes – when the fins point up and air hits them at high speed, the front of the plane is pushed up and the plane rises.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -國際對決
programme.desc: Will captain Emily be fit enough to skate with her team, and what is the surprise in store for Afton? Meanwhile, back in Nottingham, young figure skater Solomon needs to nail his axels if he wants to impress Coach Tamara.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -甜蜜的家
programme.desc: Kloe visits her family in Hungary, where she plans to find inspiration for her upcoming solo gala. Meanwhile, Josh and Ellie compete at a higher level for the first time.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -古卡馬: 最後的荒野
programme.desc: While exploring the picturesque Garden Route, the Zebrabus stumbles onto a hidden retreat with some of the highest vegetated dunes in South Africa. They face snakes and other reptiles before venturing out to sea in search of sharks.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -西海岸: 前往伯德島
programme.desc: Trying to find a shortcut to Bird Island, the youngsters end up stuck in a desolate dune field. Night falls and they encounter creatures that both scare and enthral them. They find a path to the coast and must cross a mighty river with the help of local fishermen.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -海豚
programme.desc: Today Kristina has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses, the dolphin's, eye. But can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Meet also Garoe, a one-year-old chimp and Dali, the emperor tamarin, who has an age-old problem.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -鯨喜時刻
programme.desc: Darwin, Newts and Heni look after and re-float a whale that has become stranded in the bay.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -老人家的智慧
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts meet Pupu Rangi's grandma, Kuia Gooey, and discover there's so much that our grandparents can teach us.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -黑妮的雞舍
programme.desc: When Heni's new chickens take over her garden, Darwin and Newts come up with a plan to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: 優可 -你好, 大自然
programme.desc: The kids become park rangers, but their bossiness drives people away! Yoko must work her magic to rewind time so they can re-do the day.

programme.desc: Paper planes need a new twist, so grab your scissors and try making this! Whirl show you how to make a spinning helicopter.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克造紙

programme.desc: Eric learns constellations are groups of stars and that they often have shapes that look like animals, objects, or even people. He makes a lantern that can project the constellation Ursa Major, also known as the Great Bear because it looks like a big bear in the sky.

programme.title: 體操新星 -我們等待的一切
programme.desc: It's Amelie and Phoebe's turn to head to the Artistic British Championships, and for the first time, they will be competing as seniors. Phoebe is showing a new move on the uneven bars, and Amelie is performing her new floor routine.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -重要檢查
programme.desc: Robyn and Nyatepe help transfer a sick lion into a mobile high-tech scanner unit for a critical examination. Josh and Molly are checking the competitors in a posh horse trial for signs of injury and illness. And Jamie and Bonte are helping with Leo's leg surgery.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -GOAT與賽車手
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, tennis legend, French Open, and Grand Slam winner, Roger Federer, and the world's most successful woman in Indy car racing, Danica Patrick, share their stories on becoming the best in the world.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -明星與戰士
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, Julia Roberts relives her journey to becoming an Oscar winning actress and Wladimir Klitschko shares how he became an Olympic gold medallist and record breaking world heavyweight boxing champion.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -戰場
programme.desc: The Icicles are in Austria for the Synchro World Championships. They have to pull out a show-stopping performance to beat their rivals. Josh and Kloe get into the spirit of Christmas, and disaster strikes for Charlie in his speed skating debut.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克的熊爪
programme.desc: Eric learns that many animals have developed an insulating coat of fat to keep them warm and dry. He uses this idea to create a way to put his hand in very cold water without getting hurt.

programme.title: 寵物救援隊 -分秒必爭
programme.desc: Shiloh, the German Shepherd, has started limping, and Kylee wants to find out why. Xavier rushes in with a lifeless Lorikeet. Can he and vet Karmen revive it.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -扭來扭「趣
programme.desc: In this episode we divide a standard Mobius strip into thirds. As we cut the twisty strip into three pieces, three interlocked rings appear. The magic? None of them has a twist! How is this possible.

programme.title: 神秘大探索: 科學DIY -氣體
programme.desc: It's invisible, but can put out a fire and change our voices ... In this episode Steve Spangler shows how to harness the incredible power of gas. What happens when he locks 25 people in a truck with a thousand mini-rockets filled with water and Alka-Seltzer.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -味覺
programme.desc: In this episode, Dr Chris and Dr Xand show you an experiment to put your taste buds to the test.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -黏液
programme.desc: In this episode, Dr Chris and Dr Xand look at mucus, and show you an experiment to test the power of snot.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -數學無處不在
programme.desc: This episode explores mathematical patterns in nature, such as the tessellating hexagonal units of a honeycomb, the bilateral symmetry of a leaf, and the radial symmetry of a snowflake and spider web. Math really is everywhere.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -反映鏡像書寫
programme.desc: Mirror, mirror on the wall, can you read Eric's handwriting at all? In this episode Eric explores mirror writing: a reversed way of writing seen on for instance ambulances, where the word 'AMBULANCE' is often written in a mirrored way.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -神奇數字
programme.desc: In 1949, the mathematician D. R. Kaprekar from India came up with the ‘Kaprekar's operation'. Following three fixed steps, the outcome of this operation is always 6174. How is that possible? We'll find out in this exciting episode.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -全身濕透
programme.desc: Dr Chris gets a soaking in the lab, picking a shade of purple leaves people gobsmacked in Mindbenders, and who will get snotted in Ouchology.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -完美正方形
programme.desc: In this episode we learn that reliable measurement units can be derived from everyday objects such as our arm span and our height. So, what shape are you? A square, like most of us, or rather a tall or short rectangle? Find out and be amazed.

programme.title: 體操新星 -緊張時刻
programme.desc: Luke has an attack of nerves at the English Trampoline Championships. Kashvi and Pelagia's rhythmic team set their sights on gold, and Dom Cunningham takes on an arm-popping challenge.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -皮克米
programme.desc: Pick Me, the Labrador, has a yucky wart removed from his eye, and Jimmy, the horse, has his giant gnashers cleaned. And a one-eyed owl and a cute orphaned fox cub get the Junior Vet treatment.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -太陽時間
programme.desc: In this episode we're introduced to the exciting sundial: a clock that uses the position of the sun to show what time it is. It does so by using a stick that casts a shadow upon a surface with time markings on it.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -羅傑出問題了
programme.desc: In today's episode, Roger, the dog, has eaten a tennis ball. Will he feel bouncier after an operation to remove it? Also, a pony has a hurt hoof, and there is a pig who thinks he's a dog! And Johnny and Inel find out how to help a constipated guinea pig.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -哎呀, 我的「堡」
programme.desc: Do you want to know how you can build a really big fort? In this episode Eric reveals an exciting trick. The ingredients? A lot of cushions and the mathematical 'perimeter'. So gather your pillows and get ready for some fort action.

醫生與你
programme.desc: 聲帶是位於氣管入口兩條肌肉組織，它們主要由肌肉、韌帶和黏膜組成，是人體主要的發聲器官。聲帶發炎通常由於過度用聲或病毒感染引起，出現聲音沙啞、喉嚨痛，甚至失聲等症狀。急性發炎通常在一至兩週內可痊癒，若聲音沙啞超過兩至四週仍未改善，或伴隨呼吸困難，便有可能是慢性聲帶結節(長繭)、瘜肉或更嚴重的病變，不能忽視。. 本集請來耳鼻喉科專科醫生，講解聲帶發炎的成因及治療方法，並拆解有關聲帶問題的迷思。. 主持︰梁凱寧、黃秉康醫生. 嘉賓︰鄧志豪醫生(香港中文大學耳鼻咽喉–頭頸外科學系名譽臨床助理教授).

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第三集 - 張馳豪、詹天文、冼靖峰｜錢錢錢！中國貨幣大百科
programme.desc: 今集三位嘉賓是同一選秀節目出身的同學們：張馳豪(Aska)、詹天文(Windy)和冼靖峰(Archie)。眾人分享在內地工作或旅遊的美好回憶後，就立即進入文學、歷史地理及近代成就，多方面知識大決戰！Archie、Windy和Aska即場活用成語，來一番唇槍舌劍！中國古貨幣除銅錢以外，還有種種意想不到的材質和形態！最終誰能拆解重重難題，「知」取中華知識王令牌？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：張馳豪、詹天文、冼靖峰. #中華知識王2#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#張馳豪#詹天文#冼靖峰#山西大同雲岡石窟#中國歷代貨幣.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 ： 北京篇
運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 剛過去的全運賽事中，貝俊龍歷史性摘下帆船港隊的首面全運會金牌！在明年的亞運會中，相信港隊的表現定會備受矚目。. 唱作歌手林奕匡 Phil 形象斯斯文文，卻原來是個運動型男。今次Phil由理論到實踐，從砌船開始、陸上練習，到最後親身操控帆船，乘風破浪！首次接觸帆船訓練的Phil，最後能否完成教練為他設下的挑戰.

programme.title: 十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，余念因患阿爾茨海默症的父親余志勇失蹤而報案。船廠保安張泉透露，父親昨夜在郵筒旁離奇消失。余念在郵筒中发现一封寄給「葉海棠」的1991年舊信。鏡頭切換至1991年，少女葉海棠的生活因父親的賭債和轉學生唐亦尋的出現而陷入混亂，一封憑空出現、署名唐亦尋的「情書」更讓她成為全校笑柄.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: Emission reduction is urgent as global warming and extreme weather events ravage the world. Reducing greenhouse gas emissions has become a consensus among humans. "Absorbing" and "locking" carbon dioxide from the atmosphere, preventing its release back into the air, has become another new endeavor alongside emission reduction. . Simpler in structure than humans, microalgae, single-celled organisms that have existed in oceans and rivers for millions of years, are natural carbon absorption experts. Microalgae, invisible to the naked eye, are a few micrometers in size and, like trees, rely on photosynthesis for survival. During photosynthesis, microalgae's chlorophyll converts carbon dioxide into proteins, carbohydrates, and fats while producing oxygen, thereby helping to reduce greenhouse gases in the atmosphere. . Young research teams in Hong Kong have set up demonstration sites to cultivate and breed microalgae in specially designed tanks. They have devoted great effort and explored various methods to enhance the carbon absorption capacity of microalgae, with the goal of industrializing microalgae cultivation and promoting it worldwide. Local innovation and technology companies have also commercialized the "carbon absorption experts" by installing fluorescent green "microalgae reactors" in schools and other locations. These reactors use air pumps to draw air into water-filled containers to cultivate microalgae, aligning with organizations' carbon reduction goals under ESG reporting. . Microalgae may be the "carbon absorbers," but their life cycle is short, and they gradually release carbon dioxide back into the atmosphere. Scientists in other fields continue to unleash their unlimited creativity by attempting to directly "absorb" carbon dioxide from the air. Some Western countries have already invested in the construction of large-scale facilities to capture atmospheric carbon dioxide and store it underground. In Hong Kong, researchers at universities have made preliminary developments in the "carbon dioxide reduction system," which converts carbon dioxide into raw materials for plastic chemicals. In the future, this system could potentially be applied in industrial projects to promote carbon neutrality. . Of course, tree planting remains a crucial strategy for "carbon sequestration" at present. Trees naturally reduce carbon dioxide through photosynthesis. Environmental organizations collaborate with universities to study five different types of forests in various locations in Hong Kong. By measuring plant data using instruments after selecting suitable locations, they estimate the "carbon storage" of Hong Kong's forests and their potential for carbon dioxide removal. The aim is to assist the government in formulating policies to enhance the carbon absorption capacity of forests, ensuring that forests continue to serve as a major force for "carbon sequestration" in nature. . The extent of microalgae's carbon absorption capacity is still under research. Trees can store carbon dioxide in trees and soil for long periods. Can microalgae have a similar "carbon sequestration" effect? How effective is machine-based carbon capture? These questions still require further exploration by the academic and environmental sectors.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 來自秘魯的主廚 Edgar Vigo，並非簡單複製家鄉味，而是憑藉對南美洲飲食的理解，在香港堅守墨西哥菜的正統精髓。Chef Edgar 將會為大家介紹兩款墨西哥經典菜式：朱古力黑醬雞及燉牛面頰，亦會帶 Andy 去淺嚐他喜歡的香港美食，見證他如何將南美的熱情靈魂、香港的生活節奏與墨西哥的傳統，共冶一爐.

programme.title: 再登地球之巔
programme.desc: 青藏高原，孕育了黃河、長江、瀾滄江、雅魯藏布江、恆河、印度河等十幾條大江大河，以及10萬多條冰川、1000多個湖泊和無以計數的地下水，人們稱它為「亞洲水塔」。隨着全球氣候變暖，亙古不變的亞洲水塔失去了昔日的平衡。科學家攀登珠峰，掃描測量珠峰地區最大的冰川，深入藏北無人區，鑽取湖底岩芯，首次採用載人飛機，對黃河源頭最大的冰川進行人工降雪，分析在珠峰海拔8,848公尺鑽取的冰芯。科學家期待揭示亞洲水塔過去50年的變化規律，預估未來的發展.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 聲帶是位於氣管入口兩條肌肉組織，它們主要由肌肉、韌帶和黏膜組成，是人體主要的發聲器官。聲帶發炎通常由於過度用聲或病毒感染引起，出現聲音沙啞、喉嚨痛，甚至失聲等症狀。急性發炎通常在一至兩週內可痊癒，若聲音沙啞超過兩至四週仍未改善，或伴隨呼吸困難，便有可能是慢性聲帶結節(長繭)、瘜肉或更嚴重的病變，不能忽視。. 本集請來耳鼻喉科專科醫生，講解聲帶發炎的成因及治療方法，並拆解有關聲帶問題的迷思。. 主持︰梁凱寧、黃秉康醫生. 嘉賓︰鄧志豪醫生(香港中文大學耳鼻咽喉–頭頸外科學系名譽臨床助理教授).

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今次到訪平安町，這裡的薯仔專門用來製作薯片。這種薯仔不易糖化，易於保存，油炸時也不易烤燶。製成薯片時會切成漂亮的圓形。小農夫看到在廣大的薯仔田用收割機收割的景象，覺得特別興奮.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 作為在人間神仙的檢察官，土地公決定來趙家視察灶君工作，害怕自己業績考核不達標的灶君只得求助趙家人幫忙，一家人齊心協力努力做出人人眼中幸福美好的樣子，幫助灶君度過難關.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 莎莎為店裡的冷清的生意發愁，子涵想到養一隻寵物引流，莎莎誤會子涵並被小衰神利用注入負能量導致母女倆不歡而散，失落的子涵遇到失落的灶雞，二人達成共識重新返家修復家庭關係，並在這過程中產生強烈感情，至此灶雞擁有了兩個主人並擁有一個新名字子龍.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 如福侍衛隊已有三隻脊獸在菲菲家會合，但夏美和波波面臨危險。夏美被烏鴉叼走，波波誤入菲菲奶奶的買菜車。大家合力救回夏美，卻發現文津閣已被毀，仙人失踪，如福們無家可歸，只好留在菲菲家.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 杜老師把板報設計比賽的重任交給菲菲，她決心不讓大家失望。然而，朝風突襲使板報遺失，菲菲感到沮喪。幸好如福們幫她找回板報，最終菲菲獲得比賽第一名.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在紐西蘭，養蜂人每天穿越數十萬英畝的土地，照料散佈於社區和神聖土地上的蜜蜂.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 巴卡俾格米人是狩獵採集的專家，以採集森林樹冠中野生蜜蜂的蜂蜜而聞名。由於森林中可供蜜蜂築巢的天然場所極為豐富，想要在這樣的環境中馴化蜜蜂的活動幾乎是不可能的。因此，巴卡人必須運用高度發展的技術和知識，來克服蜜蜂的狡猾天性.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: The abolition of the MPF offsetting arrangement took effect on 1 May 2025. To ease the transition, the Government has introduced a subsidy scheme to help employers cover part of the severance and long service payments under the new system. . The arrangement is not retrospective, with compensation divided into “pre-transition” and “post-transition” portions. While the MPF was designed to strengthen retirement protection, abolishing offsetting better fulfills this purpose. Beyond system improvements, how can citizens further secure their retirement.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.sub-title: 「同心築夢・百校結好」香江行
programme.desc: 由香港聖公會主辦的「『同心築夢·百校結好』香江行」是系列活動的第一站。為系列餘下的兩個活動奠下兩地持續交流的基石，促進中港學生的友誼建立，深化香港與內地的緊密聯繫。來自甘肅省的中學同學走訪香港的聖公會聖西門呂明才中學，參與觀課及參觀校園，讓甘肅省的同學體會到香港教學的獨特性.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.desc: Lebanese traditional culture is renowned for its warmth and hospitality. A young Lebanese female chef, seeking career development, gladly accepted a job offer and ventured alone to Hong Kong to manage a Lebanese restaurant. With her passion for cooking, she not only made friends but also forged her own unique realm in this international city, leaving a mark on the culinary scene.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十集：肖春生被踢出緝私隊
programme.desc: 葉芳給陳宏軍洗衣服時，發現口袋裏李上游的名片，她打電話詢問陳宏軍後，猜到事情真相。葉芳問陳宏軍肖春生的事情，陳宏軍告訴葉芳肖春生不能再待在緝私隊了。肖春生去雲南看段磊，肖春生看著段磊的腿，他覺得國家的康復器材太短缺了.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十一集：肖春生創業
programme.desc: 佟曉梅的父親問肖春生回來後有什麼打算，肖春生告訴他們自己想要創業，佟曉梅表示支持。項南帶著自己的珠寶來北京找肖春生了，肖春生帶他們找人鑒定，成功賣出這批貨。項南告訴肖春生自己缺錢，肖春生答應幫助他，項南之後告訴肖春生問他借的錢就算肖春生入股了.

programme.title: 義工善行 公務員好故事
學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集將追蹤「摩登」的流動軌跡，從巴黎的拱廊街與百貨公司談起，穿越二十世紀初「東方巴黎」上海的十里洋場，月份牌美女、改良旗袍與時尚工業的興起，新女性在傳統禮教與西式自由間尋找平衡，最後探討滬港文化互涉，發展出獨特的都市文化。. 主持. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 陳芳芳(香港浸會大學歷史系助理教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授).

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 單車港隊在多個國際賽事上表現亮眼，在剛過去的全運賽事中，李思穎更勇奪三面金牌的佳績，是極受市民追捧的運動項目之一。除了最令人印象深刻的公路及場地單車賽，山地車項目同樣在近年備受關注。. 歌手應智越（細貓）決定拿出他的「第一次」，跟教練在多變地形、崎嶇不平的山地，學習如何駕馭山地車。就連轉波、煞車都要重頭學起，細貓又是否能成功挑戰山地車這項運動.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：泛亞交響樂團 圖畫展覽會動畫音樂會
programme.sub-title: 泛亞交響樂團 圖畫展覽會動畫音樂會
programme.desc: 泛亞交響樂團成立接近五十年，一直以推廣音樂給市民大眾為理念。為吸引年青觀眾，樂團特別製作動畫，在音樂會上以投映效果融入現場演奏，呈獻穆索斯基的《圖畫展覽會》。動畫中，已逝世的前音樂總監葉惠康博士化身為卡通人物，帶領觀眾欣賞《圖畫展覽會》的畫作，光影與旋律交織，使觀眾視聽同步欣賞演出。音樂會的第一部作品是意大利著名作曲家、小提琴演奏家帕格尼尼的《第二小提琴協奏曲》，由樂團藝術總監、香港管弦樂團中提琴首席凌顯祐擔任小提琴獨奏。《演藝盛薈.開放舞台》特別搜羅是次音樂會為大家呈獻。. 音樂會片段由泛亞交響樂團攝製及提供.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：香江雅韻．絃歌不絕
programme.sub-title: 香江雅韻．絃歌不絕 （下集）
programme.desc: 竹韻小集的「香江雅韻．絃歌不絕——嶺南音樂文化傳承及實踐計劃成果巡演」獲入選國家藝術基金2023年度傳播交流推廣資助項目，精選嶺南音樂於內地巡迴展演。本地音樂會為首屆「中華文化節」節目，結集巡演曲目，以「嶺南風．香江情」為主題，由殿堂級指揮家何文川領航、高胡巨匠余其偉傾情演奏，以絲竹之音編織時光長卷，呈現粵樂作為「非遺」音樂的現代風貌。. 表演曲目. 合奏《節慶鵝頸橋》曾葉發曲. 合奏《雲枕龍脊》麥偉鑄曲. 軟弓五架頭《蘭桂騰芳》陸尉俊曲. 中西樂組合《廟街探戈》黃學揚曲. 合奏《月滿紫荊》陳思昂曲. 高胡與樂隊《粵韻同行》呂文成曲伍敬彬編曲. I.〈平湖秋月〉. II.〈步步高.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 嘉陽雖然是一位小學生，但最近獲一位人氣網紅邀請合作拍片打機，更可以賺取酬勞。他滿心歡喜，想把這個「好消息」告訴爸爸，卻遭到爸爸堅決反對。但他認為《基本法》第三十三條保障香港居民有選擇職業的自由，所以覺得爸爸的阻止不合理。就在此時時，貓頭鷹博士進一步講解《基本法》第一百四十七條，指出兒童工作受法律規管和保障，不能隨意從事。在興趣與賺錢之間，嘉陽應該怎樣作出抉擇，才既符合法律，又保障自己成長的需要呢？. 《基本法》第三十三條：. 說明香港居民有選擇職業的自由。. 《基本法》第一百四十七條：. 香港特別行政區自行制定有關勞工的法律和政策。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 龙脊曾经被国际知名的旅游指南选为「香港最佳远足路线」之一，因为和市区距离接近，加上风景怡人，所以吸引不少游客慕名而来。. 在龙脊更可以360度远眺四周景色，包括大浪湾、清水湾半岛、赤柱等等，其中位于香港岛东南部的石澳也是香港人的周末好去处。. 行完龙脊之后，主持接着去到石澳挑战攀岩活动，也请来研究岩岸生态的专家，教导他们观察依附在岩岸上，那些微小但顽强的生物.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星芒》以藏曆指引的農耕文明為脈絡，詮釋傳統智慧在新時代的傳承與煥新。達普天文台的日光精準穿石，宣告春耕啟幕，藏曆與星辰的約定在此印證。克松村的達瓦深耕傳承，讓瀕臨失傳的開耕歌舞「鍆諧」重歸田野.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.desc: 1991年，葉海棠因班費被父親搶走而絕望，寫下遺書投入郵筒，並持刀前往賭場欲刺父親，卻被唐亦尋空手奪刀攔下。唐亦尋帶她暫時避開追債人。2026年，余念被告知父親「余志勇」已死亡，她在家中發現父親的明信片，上面的字跡與神秘信件一模一樣，讓她對「葉海棠」的身份更加疑惑.

programme.title: 義工善行 公務員好故事
周末大電影 : 小教父
programme.desc: The story of young men growing up facing hard times where they have little going for them. Two opposing groups, the Greasers and the Socs, continually fight against each other and their "turf".

programme.title: 《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.desc: To sustain scientific research and carry it forward, the participation of a new generation is essential. During the Future Science Prize Week, a science popularisation special event “AI Walk and Talk” was held for young people. . A group of secondary students with a passion for science or the potential to become future scientists was led by Professor TAI Pui-kuen Amos, a young scientist, into “ISDworks!”, the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology’s innovation laboratory. There, they had close exchanges with science researchers and postgraduate students. . Inside the Robotics Laboratory, scientific theory and AI technology are being transformed into tools for daily life, with the most eye-catching one being the telepresence robot capable of face-to-face interaction. The programme showcases how knowledge is passed down and interwoven across generations, and inspires young people to build on the foundation of their predecessors in exploring the unknown and creating the future.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 嘉陽雖然是一位小學生，但最近獲一位人氣網紅邀請合作拍片打機，更可以賺取酬勞。他滿心歡喜，想把這個「好消息」告訴爸爸，卻遭到爸爸堅決反對。但他認為《基本法》第三十三條保障香港居民有選擇職業的自由，所以覺得爸爸的阻止不合理。就在此時時，貓頭鷹博士進一步講解《基本法》第一百四十七條，指出兒童工作受法律規管和保障，不能隨意從事。在興趣與賺錢之間，嘉陽應該怎樣作出抉擇，才既符合法律，又保障自己成長的需要呢？. 《基本法》第三十三條：. 說明香港居民有選擇職業的自由。. 《基本法》第一百四十七條：. 香港特別行政區自行制定有關勞工的法律和政策。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 由二人組合''Robynn & Kendy’’身份出道，2020年休團後，葉中月(Robynn)決定獨立發展，創作自己的音樂。以一個人的歌手身份走到第六個年頭，中間推出了不少作品，更發行首張個人大碟、舉行小型音樂會。從合唱到獨唱，從組合到個人，中間經歷過音樂、家庭上身份的轉變，今集就讓Robynn分享當中點滴。. 主持：崔潔彤、黎展峯. 歌曲：. -《小痕跡》. -《自問自答》. -《宇宙煙火》(黎展峯).

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星芒》以藏曆指引的農耕文明為脈絡，詮釋傳統智慧在新時代的傳承與煥新。達普天文台的日光精準穿石，宣告春耕啟幕，藏曆與星辰的約定在此印證。克松村的達瓦深耕傳承，讓瀕臨失傳的開耕歌舞「鍆諧」重歸田野.

programme.desc: 1991年，葉海棠因班費被父親搶走而絕望，寫下遺書投入郵筒，並持刀前往賭場欲刺父親，卻被唐亦尋空手奪刀攔下。唐亦尋帶她暫時避開追債人。2026年，余念被告知父親「余志勇」已死亡，她在家中發現父親的明信片，上面的字跡與神秘信件一模一樣，讓她對「葉海棠」的身份更加疑惑.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 龙脊曾经被国际知名的旅游指南选为「香港最佳远足路线」之一，因为和市区距离接近，加上风景怡人，所以吸引不少游客慕名而来。. 在龙脊更可以360度远眺四周景色，包括大浪湾、清水湾半岛、赤柱等等，其中位于香港岛东南部的石澳也是香港人的周末好去处。. 行完龙脊之后，主持接着去到石澳挑战攀岩活动，也请来研究岩岸生态的专家，教导他们观察依附在岩岸上，那些微小但顽强的生物.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: The abolition of the MPF offsetting arrangement took effect on 1 May 2025. To ease the transition, the Government has introduced a subsidy scheme to help employers cover part of the severance and long service payments under the new system. . The arrangement is not retrospective, with compensation divided into “pre-transition” and “post-transition” portions. While the MPF was designed to strengthen retirement protection, abolishing offsetting better fulfills this purpose. Beyond system improvements, how can citizens further secure their retirement.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.desc: Lebanese traditional culture is renowned for its warmth and hospitality. A young Lebanese female chef, seeking career development, gladly accepted a job offer and ventured alone to Hong Kong to manage a Lebanese restaurant. With her passion for cooking, she not only made friends but also forged her own unique realm in this international city, leaving a mark on the culinary scene.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在紐西蘭，養蜂人每天穿越數十萬英畝的土地，照料散佈於社區和神聖土地上的蜜蜂.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 巴卡俾格米人是狩獵採集的專家，以採集森林樹冠中野生蜜蜂的蜂蜜而聞名。由於森林中可供蜜蜂築巢的天然場所極為豐富，想要在這樣的環境中馴化蜜蜂的活動幾乎是不可能的。因此，巴卡人必須運用高度發展的技術和知識，來克服蜜蜂的狡猾天性.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 由二人組合''Robynn & Kendy’’身份出道，2020年休團後，葉中月(Robynn)決定獨立發展，創作自己的音樂。以一個人的歌手身份走到第六個年頭，中間推出了不少作品，更發行首張個人大碟、舉行小型音樂會。從合唱到獨唱，從組合到個人，中間經歷過音樂、家庭上身份的轉變，今集就讓Robynn分享當中點滴。. 主持：崔潔彤、黎展峯. 歌曲：. -《小痕跡》. -《自問自答》. -《宇宙煙火》(黎展峯).

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集聚焦賽事選手背後以不屈赴夢，以熱血傳神的故事，走進全盲運動員楊曉婷、單腿球王何憶義、九金王蔣裕燕，以及新疆盲人足球隊等代表人物的世界。他們身殘志堅，不懼命運挑戰，以勇往直前的信念追逐夢想，用汗水澆築榮耀，生動詮釋「向陽而生」的力量，弘揚中華體育精神，讓每一份堅持都閃耀光芒。. 播映時間：2月3日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第八集：萬里首次殺敵需要輔導
programme.desc: 萬里被野豬追趕而誤陷危機，被美軍追殺。隊友余從戎奮力保護，萬里艱難開槍，完成首次射擊。七連因位置暴露遭空襲，戰士們面臨嚴峻挑戰。萬里因殺敵心情沉重，梅生與千里對他輔導。行軍中，萬里暈倒，千里告誡萬里七連無活着的英雄.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 - 本草流芳
programme.desc: 靈芝，在中國古代神話中是常見的仙草，是神仙洞府裡的至尊之寶，被《山海經》中的上古神獸看守，需要千年時光才能長成。古人認為，靈芝能讓人起死回生，長生不老。本期節目與你一起探索這株神奇本草.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 本草流芳
programme.desc: 葛，作為最早被中國人發現並使用的植物之一，其身影縱貫歲月長河，直至今日，仍活躍於我們的生活之中。它平凡而常見，悄然生長於中國廣袤的土地上。然而，在其看似普通的表像之下，卻蘊含著驚人的生命力.

programme.title: 義工善行 公務員好故事
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第十四集: 莊圖南在上海弄堂遇到李佳
programme.desc: 林武峰偷偷地與安廠長去一趟溫州看冰箱廠的發展。莊圖南的大學老師要他們到上海的弄堂考察。李佳的叔叔嬸嬸家就是上海，不過他們對李佳沒有好臉色。莊圖南碰到李佳，下着雨二人一起走過弄堂。要中考了，林棟哲的老師覺得他還是很有潛力的，建議他父母可以沖一沖一中.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第十五集: 考上了一中
programme.desc: 林棟哲和莊筱婷都考上了一中，宋瑩非常高興。莊超英覺得孩子們現在都在進步，他們也不能落後，要去成人教育，但不喜歡讀書的宋瑩覺不太想去。今年宋瑩終於被評上了先進生產者，周科長表示宋瑩工作非常努力，車間裡面有很多人都是宋瑩帶出來的.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第二十八集：李善德拿到腰牌
programme.desc: 李善德拿到腰牌後，先去了上林署。整個上林署驚惶失措，自爆了在牡丹和牒文上陷害出賣李善德的事情。劉署令不知道之前在宮門甬道發生的事情，對李善德大聲呼喝.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 何濼嬅天生患有耳骨硬化症，耳朵一邊聽不到聲音，另一邊借助助聽器也僅有5%的聽力。自幼與人溝通多是看口型，但藉著後天的努力練習，就算聽力有限，她說話十分清晰。長大後，她去學習西廚，特別喜歡整蛋糕，在過程中她得到了滿足感。. Hugo是社企創辦人，他留意到聽障婦女在工作時展現出細膩與專注，決定在一間超市內成立一間烘焙店，其中一位烘焙師就是何濼嬅，她每天早晨負責麵包的出爐、整形與包裝。在這無聲的環境中，烘焙師傅和街坊的互動如何？今集主持Marco吳祉昊會去探訪這些安靜細心的烘焙師.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 本集帶觀眾走進西班牙飲食文化的慢活世界。從早上的西班牙薯仔蛋餅及西班牙油炸鬼開始，探索一日五餐的從容生活哲學。之後我們會近距離欣賞西班牙火腿侍肉師的精湛刀工，了解火腿分級、藝術擺盤及品嚐秘訣；再向大廚們發掘西班牙小菜的歷史，以及飯後圍桌閒聊的社交禮儀。主持透過食物連結香港急速節奏與西班牙漫遊旅程，發掘熱情、誠實、分享背後的文化故事.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 綠能革命
programme.sub-title: 綠能革命: 與時競賽(下)
programme.desc: 別再等待，立即行動。. 今集節目會探討實現技術可能性所需的步驟，造訪美國和巴伐利亞的兩個對比地點，這些地方已完全轉向可再生能源，並因此獲得更多財務資源。這些例子展示了全球能源轉型的現有解決方案，同時強調未來面臨的挑戰，並強調創新者和決策者在推動變革中的重要作用。. Don't wait, just do it. The second part of the documentary explores what needs to happen to realize technical possibilities. It visits two contrasting locations in the USA and Bavaria, both of which have fully transitioned to renewable energy and now enjoy greater financial resources. These examples highlight existing solutions for a global energy transition while also addressing the challenges ahead. The film emphasizes the importance of action from both innovators and decision-makers to drive this change forward today.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星芒》以藏曆指引的農耕文明為脈絡，詮釋傳統智慧在新時代的傳承與煥新。達普天文台的日光精準穿石，宣告春耕啟幕，藏曆與星辰的約定在此印證。克松村的達瓦深耕傳承，讓瀕臨失傳的開耕歌舞「鍆諧」重歸田野.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第九集：千里率領增援營救戰友
programme.desc: 高原寒冷，指南針失效，七連迷路。千里憂心萬里，派雷公安慰。老肖等人與美軍交火獲勝，但遭空襲。千里分兵救援老肖，梅生趕往新興里。萬里違紀尋兄，老肖彈盡糧絕，千里帶着增援及時趕到，扭轉局勢。五連等待七連期間，被美軍發現，被迫提前發動進攻.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第十六集: 棉紡廠訂單減少了
programme.desc: 紡織廠一二車間合併，老職工要退下，實習生全都不要了。張阿妹的女兒正在實習，現在進不了廠。工人在廠裡大鬧，宋瑩建議趕緊想辦法找一個工作，臨時工也好。大學老師表示雲遙那邊要拆掉古建築去修建城市，問同學有沒有願意去保護這些古建築。莊圖南和李佳都報名了.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第十七集: 師生努力保護古城
programme.desc: 棉紡廠生產的滌綸賣不出，工人工資都發不出來了，只可以用那些銷量不好的布來抵工資。莊圖南他們到了雲遙這裡來勘測，想要保留雲遙的古建築，每天都忙得很。老師要保護這些古建築的，但古城的工作人員不理會他們說的什麼傳統文化，趕緊把這些古建築拆了去發展和要修路.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第二十九集：魚朝恩與李善德處理荔枝轉運
programme.desc: 來到上林署開會的人對荔枝轉運事宜獻言獻策，李善德着人把有用的策略一一記錄，迅速被分派執行。一朝得勢，竟至如斯，讓李善德滿腹感慨。魚朝恩與李善德並肩開始處理荔枝轉運一事.

政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要

programme.desc: 唱作歌手李靖筠(Gladys)近年嘗試R&B慵懶風格，同樣身為唱作人的布志綸(Alan)，作品就揉合搖滾、抒情，風格多變。兩位將同時上《港樂．講樂》的舞台現場演唱最新派台歌，更會一齊大玩遊戲！. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. 李靖筠《最好比我更懶》. 布志綸《貼哋.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第三集 - 張馳豪、詹天文、冼靖峰｜錢錢錢！中國貨幣大百科
programme.desc: 今集三位嘉賓是同一選秀節目出身的同學們：張馳豪(Aska)、詹天文(Windy)和冼靖峰(Archie)。眾人分享在內地工作或旅遊的美好回憶後，就立即進入文學、歷史地理及近代成就，多方面知識大決戰！Archie、Windy和Aska即場活用成語，來一番唇槍舌劍！中國古貨幣除銅錢以外，還有種種意想不到的材質和形態！最終誰能拆解重重難題，「知」取中華知識王令牌？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：張馳豪、詹天文、冼靖峰. #中華知識王2#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#張馳豪#詹天文#冼靖峰#山西大同雲岡石窟#中國歷代貨幣.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第八集：羊駝出現在唐奇的家
programme.desc: 蘇橙橙去唐奇家想銷毀蘇渺在拍海報時曾留下的物品，卻被唐奇拒之門外。蘇橙橙無奈變身為蘇渺的寵物羊駝再次敲門，唐奇對萌萌的羊駝很是歡喜。蘇橙橙進屋後大肆破壞，唐奇對羊駝萬般忍耐並傾吐心事，讓她得知了唐奇對蘇渺的情感並非只是因為蘇渺的外表.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 龍仔（輕度智障），日復日地在倉庫工作，對於大多數人來說，這或許是一份單調而枯燥的工作，但在龍仔的世界裡，一切都有著自己的節奏與秩序。他用專注和堅持，將平凡的每一天過得充實且有條理。而主管Tommy不僅是龍仔上司，更是陪伴他成長的重要夥伴，一直以細心及耐性，在背後給予支持和鼓勵.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 龙脊曾经被国际知名的旅游指南选为「香港最佳远足路线」之一，因为和市区距离接近，加上风景怡人，所以吸引不少游客慕名而来。. 在龙脊更可以360度远眺四周景色，包括大浪湾、清水湾半岛、赤柱等等，其中位于香港岛东南部的石澳也是香港人的周末好去处。. 行完龙脊之后，主持接着去到石澳挑战攀岩活动，也请来研究岩岸生态的专家，教导他们观察依附在岩岸上，那些微小但顽强的生物.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.sub-title: 「同心築夢・百校結好」香江行
programme.desc: 由香港聖公會主辦的「『同心築夢·百校結好』香江行」是系列活動的第一站。為系列餘下的兩個活動奠下兩地持續交流的基石，促進中港學生的友誼建立，深化香港與內地的緊密聯繫。來自甘肅省的中學同學走訪香港的聖公會聖西門呂明才中學，參與觀課及參觀校園，讓甘肅省的同學體會到香港教學的獨特性.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: Harry 哥哥最近化身神探Harry，專門到不同學校為小鄰居排難解紛。第一集就到大埔浸信會公立學校幫助小鄰居俊仔！. 俊仔滿腔熱血，擁有一顆樂於助人的心，發夢都想做班長。誰知他的偉大抱負換來的卻是同學們反對！理由竟然是：「你又不是模範生，憑什麼選班長？」難道真的要科科考第一，才有資格成為候選人？俊仔的「班長夢」難道就此幻滅？. 不過，貓頭鷹博士為大家拆解《基本法》第二十六條，解決大家的疑惑！今集就與Harry 哥哥一同走入大埔浸信會公立學校，踏上一個關乎夢想、規則與公平的旅程！. 《基本法》第二十六條：. 香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 小四學生寶姸最近因為媽媽的管教而感到煩惱，覺得自己被迫做不想做的事，失去了自由。Harry哥哥決定出手相助，親自到學校了解情況；同時，貓頭鷹博士也透過《基本法》第四條與大家一起思考「自由」的真正意義。究竟寶姸的煩惱背後，藏着甚麼原因？Harry哥哥又能否幫她解開心結？. 《基本法》第四條：. 香港特別行政區依法保障香港特別行政區居民和其他人的權利和自由。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：千里追尋離隊的萬里
programme.desc: 認命與七連主力匯合，並引路前往戰場。十五萬志願軍潛伏於蓋馬高原，包圍美軍。大寶偽裝成韓軍逃過偵察隊，卻意外踩到地雷。千里批評萬里的逃兵行為，萬里則表達不願拖累戰友的心聲。在村莊內，志願軍與美軍偵察隊展開激烈交火.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第十八集: 莊圖南對李佳的心意
programme.desc: 莊圖南和李佳在黑房裡沖照片，兩人說起了最近的事情，莊圖南表示遇到李佳的這些時候，就是自己最相信命運的時候。莊圖南想要親李佳…同學要返回上海了，莊圖南問李佳是不是要回黑龍江，李佳表示自己回上海，自己父母這段時間來上海了。二人一起在火車上看到了日出.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第十九集: 李佳對莊圖南態度冷淡
programme.desc: 李佳的上海叔叔嬸嬸不願意讓她的弟弟住在他們的家辦落戶。李佳勸父母回黑龍江，要落戶上海就要像她這樣考上了中學或者大學。莊圖南和李佳回到校園，李佳對他的態度很冷淡，李佳說他們只是同學，幸福對於自己來說是奢侈品.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 今集收到來自小學六年級生思思的訊息，因為她眼見排隊時給領袖生及一位身體不適的同學打尖的，心裡極受委屈，感覺十分不公平，於是向Harry哥哥求助；而其他學生亦對這件事議論紛紛，到底誰對誰錯？就在大家辯論之際，貓頭鷹博士及時出現，並引用了《基本法》第二十五條；但是當公平遇上特殊情況，我們如何做到情、理、法三者兼備呢？. 《基本法》第二十五條. 香港居民在法律面前一律平等。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 嘉陽雖然是一位小學生，但最近獲一位人氣網紅邀請合作拍片打機，更可以賺取酬勞。他滿心歡喜，想把這個「好消息」告訴爸爸，卻遭到爸爸堅決反對。但他認為《基本法》第三十三條保障香港居民有選擇職業的自由，所以覺得爸爸的阻止不合理。就在此時時，貓頭鷹博士進一步講解《基本法》第一百四十七條，指出兒童工作受法律規管和保障，不能隨意從事。在興趣與賺錢之間，嘉陽應該怎樣作出抉擇，才既符合法律，又保障自己成長的需要呢？. 《基本法》第三十三條：. 說明香港居民有選擇職業的自由。. 《基本法》第一百四十七條：. 香港特別行政區自行制定有關勞工的法律和政策。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了嶺南大學科學教研部助理教授劉彥芹博士及香港生態攝影師馮漢城，分享有關香港瘰螈的生態知識。本集以水、陸瘰螈以及瘰螈胚胎作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索香港瘰螈的外貌特徵、生活習性、以及生存智慧.

programme.title: 民生美食關注組
programme.desc: 旺角豈止是購物聖地那麼簡單？原來「旺角」昔日名為「芒角」，甚至曾有一條「芒角村」。今集《民生美食關注組》將帶領大家穿梭時空，從 1866 年的地圖出發，探尋通菜街、西洋菜街及花園街背後的農村往事。. 除了細訴歷史，當然少不了尋找地道美食。主持會將直擊旺角熟食中心，品嚐餡料豐富的農夫包；隨後轉往油麻地廟街，從傳統粵曲表演中體驗地道的菲律賓美食；最後帶領大家排隊享用每日限量供應的新鮮清湯腩。讓大家一同感受油尖旺區最地道的市井煙火氣息.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第十集：唐奇對方謹有好感
programme.desc: 蘇橙橙沒想到唐奇正好在會議室目睹了一切，關勝宇想讓唐奇為方謹家暴自己作證，但蘇橙橙隨後則以方謹身分約唐奇見面，請求他能為方謹保守秘密，沒想到遭到唐奇的拒絕。然而，經過兩人在咖啡館裏的交談，唐奇看着和服務員親切互動的方謹，被她可愛親和的樣子打動.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 我家是個博物館
programme.desc: 73歲的新疆爺爺喜愛老物件，收藏老物件，希望一屋子的老物件可以傳承下去，讓以後的娃娃們能夠了解先人們用過的物件。另一邊廂，吳爾平才20歲出頭，但收藏化學元素已近十年。化學物質的美麗和奇妙吸引他集齊了1到80號的化學元素.

programme.sub-title: 第二十集: 林武峰被人告密
programme.desc: 林武峰被人告密，說了他在外面兼職的事情，廠長要林武峰要暫停技術上的工作。林棟哲知道父親出事了，變得現在非常用功讀書。林武峰跟宋瑩說在廣交會時認識的一個廣東企業，希望林武峰能到他們那裡去工作，還可以解決落戶。林武峰想去，宋瑩覺得為甚麼要跑到這麼遠.

programme.sub-title: 第二十一集: 林武峰一家到廣州
programme.desc: 宋瑩和林武峰跟林棟哲說想要去廣州發展，要把林棟哲也帶到那邊去讀書，林棟哲一口答應下來。林武峰晚上偷偷走了，表示自己這一次走不是很光彩的事情，別人不管說什麼，宋瑩都要忍住。之後，宋瑩去廣州會合林武峰，她拜託黃玲在這個暑假照顧林棟哲.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 五位勇敢的英雄接受了一個任務，要運送三十個氣球給菲斯的表弟，但事情並不是想像中那麼容易.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集《小農夫大作物新一彈》帶觀眾到訪札幌市手稻區的一間豆腐店。究竟多優質和精緻的豆腐，才能獲得日本第一的美譽？主持們亦會介紹各款健康的豆腐菜式，例如以豆渣代替肉碎的麻婆豆腐.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十二集：蘇諒徹底失望
programme.desc: 何有光不願坐以待斃，讓趙辛民發放荔枝股，先一步把這些利益給右相送過去。右相眼裏，誰能幫他斂財，誰才有價值。趙辛民來到廣場，憑藉三寸不爛之舌遊說眾人，打算發放荔枝股。蘇諒看到荔枝股，徹底失望.

programme.desc: 本集將視角從競技賽場延伸至幕後，聚焦默默為運動員逐夢築牢支撐的團體——無私奉獻的志願者、深耕科技助殘的工作者、推進場館無障礙改造的團隊、用心做好輔具服務保障的工作者。他們以責任為帆，以熱愛為槳，用默默堅守與全力付出，成為運動員最堅強的後盾，凸顯責任與熱愛交織的溫暖力量。. 播映時間：2月10日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
綠惜見未來
programme.desc: In recent years, green buildings have become a growing trend in the construction industry. Many people believe that installing solar panels or implementing greening projects automatically makes a building environmentally friendly. But is this really the case?. Buildings account for nearly 90% of Hong Kong's total electricity consumption, with residential homes, offices, and shopping malls contributing to nearly 60% of the city’s carbon emissions. Achieving energy savings and emission reductions through buildings is no easy task. On top of that, Hong Kong has over 40,000 existing older buildings. How can these aging structures be retrofitted to improve energy efficiency? What methods can be employed.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十二集：肖春生為醫院購入復健器材
programme.desc: 肖春生來到康復中心看望昔日的病友，看到他們康復器材非常緊缺。肖春生來到佟曉梅的家裏，曉梅的父親知道了肖春生的玉器生意掙了不少錢，希望春生把錢用在正道上。肖春生告訴曉梅，自己想要為康復醫院做點事，他想要給醫院弄一些復健的器材。肖春生找陳宏軍幫忙介紹.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十三集：醫院要求肖春生公司賠款
programme.desc: 肖春生創立春曉醫療，肖春生見曉梅的媽媽，他讓醫院免費試用他們的產品，醫院覺得效果好品質好再訂購。京西醫院下產品訂單，春曉醫療終於可以發工資。春曉醫療賣的貨品出現問題，醫院要求賠款，肖春生承诺還清賠款，並決定了不能依賴進口產品，他們要做自己的產品.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 港隊空手道（型）代表近年在國際賽屢創佳績，不但於2020年東京奧運歷史性獲得女子組銅牌，更登上世界排名第一，開始備受注目。. 唱作歌手鄭俊弘Fred雖然有著廣為人知的好歌喉，但他的武術運動員身份卻鮮為人知。從小練習南拳與蔡李佛拳的他首次學習以速度、力量及平衡力缺一不可的空手道（型），如何為他打開一個嶄新的武術世界.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈：粵劇 花箋記
programme.desc: 粵劇《花箋記》根據明代同名木魚書創作而成。木魚是嶺南本土曲藝類型，已有五六百年的悠久歷史。明代誕生的長篇木魚書《花箋記》是一部與《西廂記》齊名的古典文學名著，曾傳入歐洲，陸續被翻譯成英、德、法、俄、荷等版本，享譽海外。粵劇《花箋記》是首次將該作品搬上粵劇舞台，該劇為講述才子佳人的悲歡離合故事，情感細膩懇摯，打動人心。. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2025年8月30日 星期六 下午3時30分 . The Cantonese opera “The Flowery Paper” is a romantic story between a young scholar and a beautiful girl. It is the first time this story has been brought to the Cantonese opera stage. Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2025.8.30 SAT 3:30pm.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.desc: How did scientists embark on their journeys? What challenges and doubts have they come across along the way? These experiences are undoubtedly invaluable to future scientists aspiring to undertake scientific research. . The four laureates this year, Professor Xing XU, Professor Zhonghe ZHOU, Professor Xi DAI and Professor Hong DING, specially attended the talk “Dialogue with the Youth” for young people. They had close exchanges with Hong Kong secondary students from different schools, during which they delved into topics from palaeontology to forefront condensed matter physics, and shared their journeys of growth. The talk brought the Prize Week to a perfect close.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 何濼嬅天生患有耳骨硬化症，耳朵一邊聽不到聲音，另一邊借助助聽器也僅有5%的聽力。自幼與人溝通多是看口型，但藉著後天的努力練習，就算聽力有限，她說話十分清晰。長大後，她去學習西廚，特別喜歡整蛋糕，在過程中她得到了滿足感。. Hugo是社企創辦人，他留意到聽障婦女在工作時展現出細膩與專注，決定在一間超市內成立一間烘焙店，其中一位烘焙師就是何濼嬅，她每天早晨負責麵包的出爐、整形與包裝。在這無聲的環境中，烘焙師傅和街坊的互動如何？今集主持Marco吳祉昊會去探訪這些安靜細心的烘焙師.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 ： 北京篇
政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，余念前往已更名為浦水的梅灣鎮調查，遇到從英國回來尋找失蹤母親的沈程，兩人互相猜疑。1991年，葉海棠因刺父事件被孤立，唐亦尋卻默默幫她還債、墊付班費，展現溫柔一面。兩人開始探究神秘郵筒的真相，葉海棠發現自己投入的「遺書」也不見了。同時，唐亦尋三兄弟因毆打追債人，面臨黑道報復.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影：新上海灘
programme.desc: 年青軍官許文強(張國榮飾)被日軍追殺墮海,飄浮到外灘岸上,幸得丁力(劉德華飾)相救,不打不相識下結為好友.上海大亨馮敬堯(吳興國飾)利用二人剷除其他阻礙他的勢力,二人不虞有詐.強終發現當日在船上遭伏擊的幕後黑手乃馮敬堯,強抓起開信刀狂剌堯,程程(寧靜飾)不堪打擊成一瘋婦,力痛心不已,決先一步找出強算賬.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 龍仔（輕度智障），日復日地在倉庫工作，對於大多數人來說，這或許是一份單調而枯燥的工作，但在龍仔的世界裡，一切都有著自己的節奏與秩序。他用專注和堅持，將平凡的每一天過得充實且有條理。而主管Tommy不僅是龍仔上司，更是陪伴他成長的重要夥伴，一直以細心及耐性，在背後給予支持和鼓勵.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第三集 - 張馳豪、詹天文、冼靖峰｜錢錢錢！中國貨幣大百科
programme.desc: 今集三位嘉賓是同一選秀節目出身的同學們：張馳豪(Aska)、詹天文(Windy)和冼靖峰(Archie)。眾人分享在內地工作或旅遊的美好回憶後，就立即進入文學、歷史地理及近代成就，多方面知識大決戰！Archie、Windy和Aska即場活用成語，來一番唇槍舌劍！中國古貨幣除銅錢以外，還有種種意想不到的材質和形態！最終誰能拆解重重難題，「知」取中華知識王令牌？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：張馳豪、詹天文、冼靖峰. #中華知識王2#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#張馳豪#詹天文#冼靖峰#山西大同雲岡石窟#中國歷代貨幣.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: Long Chai (with mild intellectual disabilities) works daily in a warehouse. For most people, this may seem like a monotonous and tedious job, but in Long Chai's world, everything has its own rhythm and order. With focus and persistence, he leads a fulfilling and organized life each day. Supervisor Tommy is not only Long Chai's boss but also an important partner in his growth, always providing support and encouragement with care and patience. . This time, Long Chai will step out of the familiar warehouse to take on a completely different job—working as a bakery clerk. Throughout this process, Jason will accompany him, not only experiencing Long Chai's daily work routine firsthand but also witnessing how he adapts to a new environment and uncovers previously undiscovered potential. This is not just a job experience; it is an exploration of perseverance, growth, and inclusivity.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康
programme.sub-title: #6 A Versatile and All-purpose Food Ingredient – Eggs
programme.desc: This healthy food ingredient can be found in the fridge of almost every household. Kids love them, adults love them, and they show up as the star or just a sidekick in tons of dishes. Although eggs seem to be healthy and wholesome, it was once said that egg yolks would trigger the cholesterol problem. How would the latest research explain the issue? According to Chinese medicine theory, one should not consume eggs when having a wound, because eggs are “stimulating food”. How should we consume eggs for the best of our health?. In this episode, the “Food Fanatics” will bring us to a local chicken farm to see how to make hens lay quality eggs, and get tips on how to choose good eggs. In the kitchen, the chef host Will will prepare a creative “Chinese steamed egg trio” with Maggie LEUNG, and Dr TSUI Chak-cheong, Chinese medicine practitioner and a body builder, is invited to share the dos and don’ts for egg consumption. . Hosts: Maggie LEUNG, Will LEUNG (Chef). Guest: Dr TSUI Chak-cheong (Registered Chinese Medicine Practitioner).

programme.title: 31看世界 - 地球大堡礁
programme.desc: Over the past 30 years, the world has lost nearly one-third of its coral reefs. More than one billion people depand on reefs for food and hunderds of thousands of people depend on them for their livelihoods. From the most recently developed killer robots to shellfish farming, ultra-modern tactics are now proving their worth in the Great Barrier Reef to ensure the survival of this natural wonder that is the coral world and to make it possible to export this know-how to many of the world’s reefs.
